hpi: This patient presents with amenorrhea, likely secondary to polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS). She has a history of irregular menstrual cycles, obesity, and insulin resistance. The management of PCOS includes lifestyle modifications, hormonal therapy, and monitoring for potential complications such as endometrial hyperplasia. It is important to address the patient's concerns regarding fertility and provide education on the condition. Follow-up should include regular monitoring of metabolic parameters and menstrual cycle regulation.
